gloss: to abandon; to give up on; to forsake

definitions.gloss: to abandon; to give up on; to forsake
definitions.explanation: to decide that someone or something is beyond help and withdraw one's support or care

examples.japanese: ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{見放|みはな}された。
examples.english: Even the doctors gave up on him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見放|みはな}されてしまった。
⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦とうとう→とうとう：00900_toutou⟧{見放|みはな}した。
examples.english: No matter how many times I warned him, he didn't change, so I finally gave up on him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運|うん}→運：02143_un⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{見放|みはな}された⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧、⟦{不幸|ふこう}→不幸：03595_fukou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: As if forsaken by luck itself, misfortunes kept coming.

notes:
A godan verb meaning to give up on someone or something after concluding they are beyond hope. The act of {見放|みはな}す is not a momentary reaction but a considered judgment that continued support is futile.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見放|みはな}される: to be given up on by doctors
- ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見放|みはな}される: to be disowned by one's parents
- ⟦{運|うん}→運：02143_un⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見放|みはな}される: to be forsaken by fortune
- ⟦{世間|せけん}→世間：03299_seken⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{見放|みはな}される: to be abandoned by society

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見捨|みす}てる→見捨てる：14130_misuteru⟧: to abandon or desert; very close in meaning but ⟦{見捨|みす}てる→見捨てる：14130_misuteru⟧ can be more abrupt, while {見放|みはな}す implies a gradual loss of hope
- ⟦{諦|あきら}める→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧: to give up; focuses on the internal decision to stop trying, while {見放|みはな}す emphasizes withdrawing from someone else

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive. Frequently used in the passive ({見放|みはな}される) to describe being on the receiving end of abandonment.
